buildStep.cmd: npm ci 2>&1 | tail -3 && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -10

evaluatorEntrypoints.pin-parity: deploy=$(grep -oP "KIT_REF:\s*'\K[0-9a-f]+" .github/workflows/deploy.yml | head -1); workers=$(grep -oP "KIT_REF:\s*'\K[0-9a-f]+" .github/workflows/workers-deploy.yml | head -1); rustci=$(grep -oP "KIT_REF:\s*'\K[0-9a-f]+" .github/workflows/rust-ci.yml | head -1); echo "KIT_REF deploy=$deploy workers=$workers rustci=$rustci"; if [ -z "$deploy" ] || [ "$deploy" != "$workers" ] || [ "$deploy" != "$rustci" ]; then echo PIN-DRIFT-KITREF; exit 0; fi; vers=$(grep -oP 'nostr-bbs-(core|config|mesh|rate-limit) = "\K[^"]+' forum-config/Cargo.toml | sort -u); echo "crates.io versions: $vers"; nvers=$(echo "$vers" | wc -l); if [ "$nvers" -ne 1 ]; then echo PIN-DRIFT-CRATE-VERSIONS; exit 0; fi; record='docs/architecture/kit-compatibility-record.md'; canonical=$(grep -oP 'CANONICAL_KIT_SHA=\K[0-9a-f]+' "$record" 2>/dev/null | head -1); canonical_ver=$(grep -oP 'CANONICAL_KIT_VERSION=\K.+' "$record" 2>/dev/null | head -1); echo "record SHA=$canonical ver=$canonical_ver"; if [ "$canonical" != "$deploy" ]; then echo PIN-DRIFT-RECORD-SHA; elif [ "$canonical_ver" != "$vers" ]; then echo PIN-DRIFT-RECORD-VER; else echo PIN-PARITY-OK; fi

extraDisciplines: upstream-kit-out-of-scope: the nostr-rust-forum kit and every nostr-bbs-* crate are ANOTHER DREAMER'S territory. Never evaluate, patch, or hypothesise about kit internals here. Record kit-level observations as lines beginning 'HANDOFF (kit):' in the report and reference them in the ledger prior-fates column so the kit's own dream cycle picks them up
operator-overlay-first: this repo owns branding, kit pinning, deploy config, CI workflows, and site content — every hypothesis and candidate change must land in THIS repo's files
